channel.title: Patrick's Listening List
channel.description: Papers Patrick is reading, turned into two-host podcast episodes. In each episode, Alex and Jordan unpack one paper — what it argues, how the argument works, and where it is vulnerable.
channel.itunes:author: Patrick Doyle

item.title: How to Build Your Dream Life
item.description: Alex and Jordan unpack Jay Yang's permissionless playbook — help the people who have the life you want, audit their problems, pitch with proof of work — and stress-test it for survivorship and what happens when everyone copies it.

item.title: You Are Not Broken, You Are Dysregulated
item.description: Maya and Theo unpack George Ferman's viral argument that much of what looks like ADHD is a phone-built dopamine tolerance problem — the recalibration protocol, where the science is thin, and the 350-dollar program waiting at the end.

item.title: How to Build Wealth as a Career Person
item.description: Alex and Jordan unpack Asher Adeniyi's argument that a salaried career, run like an engine, is a reliable path to wealth — career capital, the five forms of capital, and converting a salary into ownership.

item.title: OCEAN Wealth Profiles
item.description: Maya and Theo unpack Exley, Doyle, Grable and Campbell's latent profile analysis of Big Five personality and money — the Undercontrolled, the Resilient, and the Overcontrolled, and what each profile earns, risks, and feels. Yes, that Doyle.

item.title: Existence Is Evidence of Immortality
item.description: Alex and Jordan unpack Michael Huemer's paper arguing that your being alive right now is Bayesian evidence you will be reincarnated — infinite time, Poincaré recurrence, permissive theories of persons, and two very diabolical demons.

item.title: Digital Twins Are Funhouse Mirrors
item.description: Alex and Jordan unpack a Science Advances mega-study testing whether AI digital twins of individuals actually predict human behavior, and the five systematic distortions the researchers found.
